story.festival_lights.name: Festival of lights
story.festival_lights.desc: A festival-of-lights challenge: light up your base with thirty lights; scan the fir trees if you find some.
story.festival_lights.ch.c1.sum: Place thirty lights at your base. On a cold world, scan ten conifers for the tips log.
story.festival_lights.r1.start: A festival of lights is on! All over the world people hang lamps and lanterns tonight. Light up your base with thirty lights and I have coloured ones for you.
story.festival_lights.graduated: Beautiful. Red and green lamps and warm light strips for the next festival of lights.
story.festival_lights.d1.start: Place thirty lights: lanterns, torches, coloured lamps, light strips, a campfire — anything that glows.
story.festival_lights.d1.done: Thirty lights! Your base can be seen from orbit.
story.festival_lights.d2.start: Conifers grow on the cold worlds — tundra, boreal, glacier. Scan ten different ones with the hand scanner.
story.festival_lights.d2.done: Ten conifers scanned. Fir trees in the lights festival — perfect.
